intent: Compare the old receipt's ex-VAT subtotal against today's catalogue ex-VAT total for the same line items and answer whether they stay within 1 EUR.
success_criteria: The receipt FILE under /uploads/ is located via List and read (never read the directory path directly)
old_ex = the printed receipt SUBTOTAL line (sum of every line item qty*unit; OCR may write 0 for O, e.g. 'SUB T0TAL')
Each receipt line item SKU is matched to catalogue product_variants EXACTLY first, then FUZZY (0/O, 1/I, 5/S, 8/B, 2/Z interchangeable) before being treated as discontinued
today_ex = SUM over EVERY receipt line item of qty * catalogue price_cents / 100 (price_cents is ex-VAT/net, NO division by 1+vat); a genuinely-absent SKU contributes 0, not its old price
diff = abs(today_ex - old_ex); answer <YES> if diff <= 1 EUR else <NO>
refs cites the exact receipt file path under /uploads/

args.stdin: SELECT product_sku, record_path, price_cents, price_currency FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku IN (:receipt_skus);

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Old receipt ex-VAT subtotal = {old_ex} EUR; today's catalogue ex-VAT total for the same items = {today_ex} EUR; diff = {diff} EUR (threshold 1 EUR). {YES_or_NO}
